# References and further reading {.unnumbered}

## Where to go next

- @franconeri2021: a readable review of the research evidence on what works in visual communication.
- @wilke2019: a free online book with excellent side-by-side good and bad examples, written by a ggplot2 developer.
- @healy2018: a free online book teaching ggplot2 with social science data.
- @rougier2014: ten short, practical rules for better scientific figures.
- @crameri2020: why rainbow colour maps distort data and exclude readers, and what to use instead.
- @weissgerber2015: why bar charts of means hide the data, with practical alternatives.
